findings.summary: Loading uses a bespoke plain-text "جارٍ تحميل…" paragraph instead of the shared LoadingScreen skeleton primitive.
findings.fix:
Replace the `

جارٍ تحميل بيانات التوظيف…

` with the shared `` (import from '../../ui/LoadingScreen') so the page matches the app's loading pattern instead of a raw text line.

findings.summary: The stage-move `<select>` in the ATS table row is icon/context-only with no accessible name (no aria-label).
findings.fix: Add `aria-label={`نقل ${application.candidateName} إلى مرحلة`}` (or a static "نقل إلى مرحلة") to the `<select className="input max-w-48">` so screen-reader users know what the control changes.

findings.summary: The candidates/stages table is hand-rolled (`w-full min-w-[900px]` + manual `bg-[var(--surface-muted)]` thead) instead of using the shared `.data-table` class used elsewhere.
findings.fix: Apply `className="data-table"` to the `<table>` (keep `min-w-[900px]` if needed) so it inherits sticky header, hover, and header weight styling consistent with other management tables.

findings.summary: Table header cells lack `scope="col"`, weakening screen-reader table navigation.
findings.fix: Add `scope="col"` to each `<th className="p-3">` in the thead row (المرشح/الوظيفة/المرحلة/تاريخ التقديم/نقل إلى).

findings.summary: The Dialog overlay backdrop uses a hardcoded Tailwind color `bg-slate-950/60` instead of a design token, so it won't adapt to the theme system.
findings.fix: Replace `bg-slate-950/60` with a token-based overlay (e.g. a shared `.modal-overlay` class or `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--text-primary)_60%,transparent)]`) consistent with other dialogs in the app.

findings.summary: Error state is rendered with EmptyState but there is no visual distinction (no danger token/icon) that this is an error rather than an empty result.
findings.fix: Pass a danger-styled indicator to the error EmptyState (e.g. an AlertTriangle icon and/or `--danger` accent) to differentiate the "تعذر تحميل" error from the normal empty states used elsewhere on the page.

findings.summary: The "اعتماد التعيين" primary hire button relies on a spinner-less disabled state during a pending async mutation with no busy affordance.
findings.fix: Add `aria-busy={workbenchCommands.hireApplicant.isPending}` and a "جارٍ…" label swap (matching the dialog submit buttons at lines 237/255/273) so the pending state is communicated consistently.

findings.summary: Header action buttons are packed inline with no icon aria treatment and the description/actions are the only header spacing—minor inconsistency with other pages using PageHeader eyebrow.
findings.fix: Consider adding an `eyebrow` prop (e.g. "إدارة الموارد") to PageHeader to match sibling management pages that use the eyebrow slot for section context; otherwise this is acceptable.
